result.summary: The metadata-address protection has a concrete numeric-host bypass. Tests could not run because pytest and application dependencies are unavailable.

findings.title: Alternate numeric hosts bypass metadata SSRF protection
findings.body: The new validator accepts `http://2852039166`, although the system resolver interprets that numeric host as `169.254.169.254` (verified with AI_NUMERICHOST, without DNS). In web/validation.py:150–171, it misses BLOCKED_HOSTS and falls through the ip_address ValueError branch. An enabled instance passes its unchanged URL through startup.py:153–160 to clients/base.py:29–35 for outbound requests. This defeats the metadata restriction this change explicitly introduces; it does not require DNS rebinding. Full HTTP execution was not tested because httpx is unavailable.
findings.recommendation: Reject noncanonical numeric IP forms or normalize them before applying the blocked-address checks. Add regression coverage for decimal `2852039166` and hexadecimal `0xa9fea9fe` metadata hosts.

next_steps: Close the numeric-host bypass and run config-validation tests with application dependencies installed.
